caption: The three tasks ask for U = 0.90 of the CPU. That is under the EDF limit of 1 but over the rate-monotonic bound of 0.7798 for n = 3, so only EDF guarantees every deadline.

spec.title: Schedulability test, worked example
spec.aria: A flowchart that adds the three task shares to get U = 0.90, then splits into two tests: EDF, where 0.90 ≤ 1 so all deadlines are met, and rate-monotonic, where 0.90 > 0.7798 so deadlines are not guaranteed.
